Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.

independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

expectation

status (accept/reject/unresolved),

parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Iteration 14/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_012 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_005 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_015 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_002 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_016 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_007 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_013 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_014 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_004 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_009 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_010 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_001 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_008 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_003 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_006 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_011 (CRISPR dependency score). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Select up to 12 existing claim references in run_analyses. This requests analyses now; previously tested comparisons reuse their data and give no new sample. New results enter the ledger after this form is accepted and are assessed in appraise. Any assessment in this form must use evidence already in the supplied ledger.

The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link

Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without

evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.

record.narrative: All estimates are interpreted exactly as already signed to the registered hypothesis direction. Because the dependency outcomes are mostly negative, I used approximate 10% absolute-mean thresholds to judge clinical importance. H170 and H176 test the accepted central outcome_006 feature_021 contrast within feature_020 absent and present. Both are enormous and decisive: H170 R159 is +0.7973 with 95% CI +0.7752 to +0.8193; H176 R162 is +0.8166 with 95% CI +0.7738 to +0.8594. These far exceed the approximate outcome_006 threshold near 0.0093 and are far from null, so I accept both strata as robust dataset-specific replications of the feature_021 association and close them. This strongly supports that the feature_021 association is not collapsed or qualitatively reversed by feature_020 status. H171 tests outcome_006 feature_020 absent versus present within feature_021 present; R160 is +0.0424 with 95% CI +0.0003 to +0.0846. The point estimate is clinically meaningful, but the lower bound is essentially null and below the clinical threshold, so I do not accept this conditional stratum as a robust clinically meaningful effect. I leave it unresolved and active because it helps clarify whether H111 is independent, outcome_006-specific, or marker-correlated. H178 tests outcome_006 feature_020 absent versus present within feature_021 absent; R163 is +0.0231 with 95% CI -0.0003 to +0.0464. It is directionally supportive but not statistically robust, so unresolved active. H172 is the formal feature_020-by-feature_021 interaction; R161 is +0.0194 with 95% CI -0.0287 to +0.0674. Although the point estimate exceeds the approximate outcome_006 threshold, the interval crosses null and is wide. Given multiplicity and the conditional pattern, I reject the claim of a clinically meaningful interaction in this dataset and close it. The cross-outcome feature_020 contrasts are mostly negative or non-threshold: H166 outcome_001 +0.0165 vs threshold about 0.0415 and interval crosses null; H167 outcome_005 +0.0119 vs threshold about 0.0250; H168 outcome_008 +0.0136 vs threshold about 0.0282; H169 outcome_013 -0.0046; H173 outcome_012 -0.0205 opposite the registered direction; H175 outcome_011 +0.0059; H183 outcome_014 -0.0066. I reject all of these for the original claims and close them. Overall, feature_021 remains a very broad and robust measured association for outcome_006 in this dataset, whereas feature_020 is best interpreted as a narrower outcome_006-specific marginal association that arose from a marker screen. This does not establish causality, leakage, mechanism, or external generalizability. No validation can be requested because the validation budget is exhausted.

I therefore reject H154 and close the investigation. This strengthens the interpretation that the central feature_021 association is outcome_006-specific rather than a broad dependency-score association. The strongest supported dataset-specific finding remains outcome_006 feature_021 absent versus present. H107 discovery gave signed estimate +0.8019 with CI +0.7823 to +0.8216, and independent validation gave +0.8115 with adjusted CI +0.7821 to +0.8408, far exceeding the outcome_006 clinical threshold around 0.0093. Stratum checks across feature_002, feature_034, feature_047, feature_060, feature_061, and feature_039 all remained near the same very large magnitude, and corresponding interaction claims were rejected as clinically meaningful modification. This is an accepted measured association in the supplied dataset, not a causal effect, leakage statement, mechanism claim, or external generalization claim. H111 outcome_006 feature_020 absent versus present remains accepted at the marginal discovery level: signed estimate +0.0595 with 95% CI +0.0148 to +0.1043, raw difference indicating stronger measured dependency in feature_020 absent cells. Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.

record.narrative:
All estimates are interpreted exactly as signed to the registered hypothesis direction. For these mostly negative CRISPR dependency outcomes, I used approximate 10% absolute-mean thresholds to judge clinical relevance. The eight cross-outcome feature_020 contrasts (H174 outcome_016, H179 outcome_004, H180 outcome_010, H181 outcome_007, H182 outcome_009, H184 outcome_015, H185 outcome_002, H186 outcome_003) were non-threshold, opposite direction, or crossed null. Their relevant thresholds were about 0.0245 to 0.0260, while most estimates were around zero or far below threshold. I reject these cross-outcome feature_020 claims and close them. This strengthens the interpretation that feature_020 is not a broad dependency-score marker in this dataset; its supported signal is outcome_006-specific.

The feature_047-stratified outcome_006 feature_020 checks remain scientifically ambiguous. record.narrative:
All estimates are interpreted exactly as signed to the registered hypothesis direction. For outcome_006, whose overall mean is about -0.093, I treated an approximate absolute effect of 0.0093 (10% of the outcome scale) as the clinical-significance benchmark. A positive signed estimate in these feature_020 absent-versus-present contrasts means the absent group has a more negative outcome_006 score, i.e. stronger measured dependency in this dataset.

The strongest new supportive stratum is H195: within feature_060=0, the feature_020 absent-versus-present association is signed +0.0881 with 95% CI +0.0214 to +0.1548. Because the entire interval lies above the approximate 0.0093 threshold, this is strong dataset-specific evidence for the association in that subgroup. Similarly, H197 within feature_002=1 is signed +0.0853 with CI +0.0215 to +0.1492, again entirely above threshold. I accept both and close them as established context-supported associations.

H189 is more equivariant: in feature_034=1, signed +0.0670 has CI +0.0059 to +0.1280. It excludes the null, which is evidence against pure chance, but the lower bound is below the clinical threshold. Given multiplicity and the need for a scientifically meaningful difference, I do not accept it yet, but it remains active unresolved because the point estimate is clinically large and it provides some support for H111.

H190, H194, H198, H202, H203, and H201 have point estimates above or near the clinical threshold but intervals that are too wide and too close to zero to establish clinically meaningful subgroup effects. H190 feature_034=0 (+0.0498, CI -0.0165 to +0.1161), H194 feature_060=1 (+0.0350, CI -0.0253 to +0.0954), H198 feature_002=0 (+0.0326, CI -0.0304 to +0.0956), H201 older age (+0.0279, CI -0.0725 to +0.1284), H202 feature_045=1 (+0.0810, CI -0.0031 to +0.1651), and H203 feature_045=0 (+0.0532, CI +0.0001 to +0.1063) are therefore unresolved and deferred. They do not refute H111; they mainly reflect small comparator cells or imprecision around the threshold. H203 deserves caution because its interval only barely excludes null and is far below the clinical threshold at the lower end, so it should not be promoted to accepted without more precise evidence.

The interaction claims test robust effect modification. H191 feature_034 (+0.0172, CI -0.0727 to +0.1071), H199 feature_002 (+0.0527, CI -0.0367 to +0.1422), and H204 feature_045 (+0.0278, CI -0.0714 to +0.1270) all cross null and are too imprecise to support clinically meaningful interaction. I reject the robust-interaction claims and close them. This rejection means only that current evidence does not establish robust modification; it does not prove no modification or no marker correlation.

Net interpretation: the new evidence strengthens H111 as a marginal outcome_006-specific dataset association because two context strata are robustly above threshold and none of the formal interactions provide reliable evidence that the effect is confined or reversed. However, specificity remains incompletely resolved because several strata are underpowered and prior feature_021 stratum attenuation plus feature_047/feature_064 ambiguity leave open the possibility of correlated-marker context effects. The validation budget is exhausted, so no validation was requested. No causal, mechanistic, leakage, or external generalizability claims are made.

Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Assess new validation and any response deadlines listed below. Explain what you conclude and what to investigate next. Accepted claims update automatically.

record.narrative:
No new validation was released and no response deadline is pending. With zero new voluntary validation requests remaining, no validation was requested. I left the accepted conclusions in force and moved the two most informative conditional outcome_006 feature_020 checks, H171 and H178, to active investigation.

The dominant dataset-specific measured association is outcome_006 with feature_021 absent versus present. Under the registered direction, H107 has signed discovery estimate about +0.802 (95% CI +0.782 to +0.822) and independent validation about +0.811 (CI +0.782 to +0.841). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Select up to 12 existing claim references in run_analyses. This requests analyses now; previously tested comparisons reuse their data and give no new sample. New results enter the ledger after this form is accepted and are assessed in appraise. Any assessment in this form must use evidence already in the supplied ledger.

record.narrative: I audited the newly delivered feature_020 conditional outcome_006 evidence using the registered signed directions and the approximate outcome_006 clinical benchmark of about 0.0093, consistent with the earlier 10% scale criterion. It remains unresolved and is deferred as a lower-priority imprecise stratum. H205 (older-age interaction, R196) has signed estimate -0.0302 with interval (-0.1464, +0.0861). The point is in the opposite direction of the registered positive-interaction claim and the interval is not informative; I reject the robust older-age interaction claim and close that exact investigation. This rejection means current evidence does not establish robust positive interaction, not that no modification could exist. H206 (feature_021=1 and feature_002=1 joint stratum, R197) is the most supportive new conditional mean difference: signed +0.0583 with interval (+0.0013, +0.1154). It excludes the null but the lower bound is below the approximate clinical benchmark, and the feature_020=1 comparator cell has n=45, so it is not robust enough to accept as a clinically meaningful subgroup effect. I keep it active because it directly informs the feature_020 specificity question. H207 (feature_021=1 and feature_002=0, R198) has signed +0.0230 with interval (-0.0411, +0.0871), crosses zero, and is imprecise; it is unresolved and deferred. H208 (feature_021=0 and feature_002=1, R199) has signed +0.0363 with interval (+0.0047, +0.0679); it supports H111 but again fails the stricter criterion that the whole interval exceed the clinical benchmark. record.narrative: No new validation was released and no response deadlines are pending; the voluntary validation budget is exhausted. Final synthesis: The strongest dataset-specific measured association is outcome_006 with feature_021 absent versus present. Under signed H107, discovery mean difference is approximately +0.802 with 95% CI +0.782 to +0.822, and independent validation is +0.811 with CI +0.782 to +0.841. On the raw dependency scale, feature_021=0 cells have much lower, more negative outcome_006 scores in this supplied dataset. This effect is far above the approximate outcome_006 clinical scale benchmark near +0.0093 and remains large across tested marker strata, while tested interactions are generally null or imprecise. The second supported association is outcome_006 with feature_020 absent versus present, H111 signed +0.0595 with 95% CI +0.0148 to +0.1043, also above the benchmark. Feature_020 also showed robust accepted marker strata H197 within feature_002=1 and H195 within feature_060=0. However, feature_020 specificity remains incomplete: H171 within feature_021=1 excludes null but does not wholly exceed the clinical benchmark, H178 within feature_021=0 crosses null, and H206/H208 are supportive but imprecise or not wholly clinically robust. Formal tested interactions were not robustly supported, so current evidence does not establish marker-context effect modification, although it cannot rule it out. The most informative next within-dataset analyses are focused conditional checks: whether the feature_020 association is concentrated in feature_002=1 within feature_021=0, whether it persists in the feature_002=1 and feature_060=0 intersection, and whether attenuation appears in feature_060=1 with feature_021=0 or feature_047=1 with feature_021=0. These proposals are registered. Most other predictor-outcome comparisons were negative or too imprecise: feature_060, feature_002, feature_047, feature_023, feature_034, feature_037, feature_021 in non-outcome_006 outcomes, and many categorical predictors had intervals spanning null or effects below the clinical benchmark. Several promising discovery effects failed validation, including H19, H23, H57/H64, H62, H72/H74, H83/H74, H94/H95, and H154. Thus the scientific conclusions are limited to dataset-specific measured associations, with no causal, mechanistic, leakage, or external generalizability claim.

Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.

First, it broadens the predictor screen beyond the heavily tested feature_021, feature_020, feature_060, feature_047, feature_042, feature_008, feature_023, feature_034, feature_037, feature_055, and feature_063 comparisons by evaluating untested binary and categorical measured contexts, including outcome_006 feature_022 present versus absent, outcome_006 feature_019 level_001 versus level_002, outcome_008 feature_028 level_002 versus level_003, and outcome_013 feature_048 level_001 versus level_003. Second, it continues the specificity question for the accepted but smaller outcome_006 feature_020 signal by asking whether the feature_020 absent-versus-present association is modified by feature_034 or feature_045 after removing the very large feature_021 signal, i.e., within feature_021=0. These conditional interaction refinements link to earlier full-population interaction tests H191 and H204. For binary and categorical mean-difference claims with direction -1, a positive signed estimate means the exposed marker or exposed level is associated with a more negative dependency score than the comparator. For feature_020 exposed=0 versus comparator=1 with direction -1, a positive signed mean difference means feature_020 absent is associated with a more negative outcome_006 score, and a positive signed interaction means that absent effect is stronger in the focal subgroup than in its complement, whereas a negative signed interaction indicates attenuation. These are falsifiable within-dataset association tests, not causal, mechanistic, leakage, or external-generalizability claims.

refinements to the earlier parent claim.

You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.

expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).

evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.

Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

I audited the new discovery evidence with the registered signed directions and outcome-specific approximate 10% absolute-mean clinical thresholds: about 0.0093 for outcome_006 and outcome_014, 0.028 for outcome_008, and 0.027 for outcome_013. Acceptance would require the entire signed 95% interval to exceed the clinically meaningful positive benchmark, adequate comparison cells, and low multiplicity risk. No new claim meets that standard. H215: feature_002 effect modification of the feature_020 contrast within feature_021=0 is estimated at +0.0259 (95% CI -0.0209 to +0.0727). It crosses the null and the lower bound is below the outcome_006 benchmark; I reject the robust positive interaction claim and close the exact test. This does not prove absence of modification, only that this tested context does not establish it. H216: the feature_020 absent-versus-present contrast in feature_002=1 and feature_060=0 is the strongest new supportive mean difference (+0.0745), but the interval (-0.0165 to +0.1654) crosses null and the comparator cell is n=89. It is not clinically established; I keep it unresolved and active because it is a focused specificity stratum. H217 and H218: feature_020 contrasts within feature_021=0 plus feature_060=1 or feature_047=1 are small and imprecise (+0.0160 and +0.0174) with lower bounds below null or below the clinical benchmark. They are unresolved and deferred. H219, H220, and H222: broad screens for feature_022, feature_019 level_001 versus level_002, and feature_048 level_001 versus level_003 have intervals crossing zero and/or point estimates near or below the benchmark. They remain unresolved and deferred, mainly because multiplicity is large and comparator precision is insufficient for robust conclusions. H221: feature_028 level_002 versus level_003 on outcome_008 is estimated opposite to the registered signed direction (-0.0277, 95% CI -0.0783 to +0.0230). The positive-side upper bound is below the approximate outcome_008 benchmark of 0.028, so the registered direction is rejected and closed; the opposite association is not established either. H223: feature_034 effect modification within feature_021=0 is negative and imprecise (-0.0102, 95% CI -0.0566 to +0.0362), crossing null; I reject robust positive interaction and close the exact test. H224: feature_045 effect modification within feature_021=0 is negative (-0.0485, 95% CI -0.0973 to +0.0003). The registered positive-interaction claim is rejected because the upper bound is essentially at zero and far below the clinical benchmark; the pattern is suggestive of attenuation of the feature_020 absent-versus-present contrast in feature_045=1 after removing feature_021=1, but this is not a robust registered reversal and should not be interpreted causally. Overall, the new feature_020 conditional analyses support but do not sharpen H111 beyond dataset-specific association, and the broad predictor screens are mostly inconclusive. Given the many subgroup and interaction tests, I am deliberately conservative: only the very large feature_021 signal and the previously accepted feature_020 signal remain supported. record.narrative: I audited the newly delivered discovery evidence using the registered signed directions: for all direction -1 outcome_006 claims, a positive signed estimate means the exposed group or exposed nominal level is associated with a more negative CRISPR dependency score. The approximate outcome_006 clinical benchmark is about 0.0093, the 10% absolute-mean threshold, given the overall mean near -0.093. Because the subgroup and interaction tests are numerous and validation capacity is exhausted, I required the lower bound of the signed 95% interval to exceed this benchmark, with adequate cells, before accepting a direction-specific claim. No validation was requested because remaining_new_requests is 0. H225 (feature_020 absent versus present within feature_021=0 and feature_045=0) is statistically positive, +0.0367 (95% CI +0.0082 to +0.0652), but the lower bound is just below the clinical benchmark; I cannot confidently claim a clinically meaningful effect, so it is unresolved and deferred. H226 within the same feature_021=0 stratum but feature_045=1 is negative and imprecise (-0.0118, CI -0.0516 to +0.0280); the registered positive direction is unsupported and the exact test is closed. H227 (feature_022 within feature_021=0) and H228 (feature_019 level_001 versus level_002 within feature_021=0) do not support the registered directions: H227 is only point-estimate near the benchmark and imprecise (+0.0097, CI -0.0157 to +0.0352), so it remains deferred, while H228 has a point estimate in the opposite direction (-0.0088, CI -0.0300 to +0.0123) and is rejected. H229 through H232 test feature_020 within various feature_021=0 marker intersections. All have intervals crossing null despite point estimates above the benchmark; they are unresolved and deferred. H233 is the key new positive result: within feature_021=1 and feature_060=0, the feature_020 absent-versus-present effect is +0.0681 (95% CI +0.0099 to +0.1262), and its lower bound exceeds the approximate clinical benchmark with comparator n=42. I accept this as a dataset-specific subgroup association, while noting it is borderline, modest in size, not independently validated, and not evidence of mechanism or causality. H234 and H235, which examine feature_020 within feature_021=1 and either feature_034=1 or feature_045=0, remain unresolved and deferred because their intervals cross null and they add to multiple-comparison risk. H236 formally tests positive interaction of the feature_020 effect by feature_021 within feature_060=0; the estimate is positive (+0.0358) but the interval includes null (-0.0305 to +0.1020), so robust positive modification is rejected and the exact test is closed. Overall, the new evidence refines the earlier feature_020 signal by suggesting it may be concentrated within feature_021=1/feature_060=0 contexts, whereas the feature_021=0 strata and nominal predictor screens remain inconclusive or unsupported. These are associations measured in this supplied dataset only, not causal, mechanistic, leakage-free, or externally generalizable claims.

refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.

and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.

comparison cell.

hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator

record.narrative: No new validation was released and there were no assessments_due or validation response deadlines; remaining independent validation requests are zero. I therefore made only investigation bookkeeping: H111 remains accepted but its investigation is closed because the feature_020 absent-versus-present outcome_006 association has been adequately characterized in discovery and no validation capacity remains; several unresolved feature_020 subgroup claims were deferred pending any future independent data. Supported findings: outcome_006 feature_021 absent (0) versus present (1) is the only robust clinically meaningful measured association (H107 signed +0.8019, 95% CI +0.7823 to +0.8216; independent validation R121 +0.8115, +0.7821 to +0.8408). Because estimates are signed, this means feature_021 absent is associated with much more negative outcome_006, i.e. stronger measured dependency, far above the approximate 10% absolute-mean benchmark (~0.0093). This association is stable across tested marker strata, including feature_034, feature_047, feature_060, feature_002, age, feature_039, and feature_020 strata, and no interaction showed robust modification. Secondary supported dataset-specific association: outcome_006 feature_020 absent versus present (H111 +0.0595, +0.0148 to +0.1043), above the benchmark but unvalidated. Its accepted subgroup refinements are H195 within feature_060=0 (+0.0881, +0.0214 to +0.1548), H197 within feature_002=1 (+0.0853, +0.0215 to +0.1492), and H233 within feature_021=1 and feature_060=0 (+0.0681, +0.0099 to +0.1262), the latter only barely above benchmark with comparator n=42 and not independently validated. Negative and unsupported: the large majority of binary and categorical predictor contrasts across all 16 outcomes were either null, opposite to the registered direction, below clinical relevance, or failed validation; examples include earlier discoveries H57, H62, H72, H74, H94/H95 and many feature_020 tests on other outcomes, as well as feature_022, feature_019, feature_055, feature_063, feature_036, feature_048, feature_047, and feature_023 lines. Iteration 20/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_012 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_005 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_015 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_002 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_016 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_007 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_013 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_014 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_004 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_009 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_010 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_001 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_008 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_003 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_006 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_011 (CRISPR dependency score). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.

Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.
